title: Offline consolidation and governed ontology evolution
summary: Offline consolidation (dreaming) and governed, feedback-driven ontology/memory evolution dominate; three findings relevant to World0, all at V1 verification.
open_questions: What quantitative gains do MemDream and OaK report, and on which benchmarks?
Do dream repairs cause semantic drift in typed relations?
Is there 2026 work on world models relevant to concept graphs?
next_priorities: Obtain full texts of OaK, MemDream, Auto-Dreamer; fill authors and results.
recommendations: Prototype a non-RL dream cycle reusing existing projection-eval scripts (E-001).
Add a validation gate for LLM-written cards/relations (E-002).
Keep structure as shared concept-world with context-conditioned projection; do not adopt per-task ontologies wholesale.

insights.label: SPECULATIVE
insights.note: Only SCM pairs a self-model with consolidation; prototype-scale.

insights.label: EXPERIMENTAL
insights.note: MemDream and Auto-Dreamer indicate a growing offline-consolidation line.

insights.label: SPECULATIVE
insights.note: No 2026 world-model result recovered in this session's searches.

insights.label: SUPPORTED
insights.note: Multiple independent papers converge on governed, feedback-driven consolidation.
